public.text: The examples emphasise programme systems, national information systems, registries, and spreadsheets. Some settings remain substantially paper-based or depend on hybrid paper-digital workflows.
public.suggestedRevision: Explicitly include paper records, manual registers, phone-based reporting, disconnected desktop applications, and informal data exchange as valid starting conditions that the architecture assessment must document.
